name: code
description: What does this existing code do? core primes a repository once with a deterministic zero-token knowledge graph via graphify (or a quick read-only mode) and hands instruction files to agentic:keys. research-codebase and trace document code as it is, with the codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer and codebase-pattern-finder agents; why answers design-rationale questions from every source it can reach. deepwiki generates and maintains wiki docs with line-level citations and validated Mermaid diagrams, including brownfield documentation for agents. code-tour writes CodeTour walkthroughs. explain-diff turns a diff, branch or PR into a self-contained HTML explainer with a quiz and architecture:blueprint diagrams, and narrates itself when a local text-to-speech service is available. explain-diff is adapted from Geoffrey Litt's explain-diff gist; see NOTICE.md.
